name: codeshave
description: High-speed AST code compressor and MCP server for Claude. Reduces code prompt tokens by 90%+ while preserving 100% valid AST structure, types, and class interfaces.

tools.name: shave_code
tools.description: Compress raw source code into an AST skeleton, stripping execution bodies while preserving classes, methods, docstrings, and type signatures.

tools.name: shave_file
tools.description: Read a file from disk and return its compressed AST skeleton.
